label: ZBTB16::RARA

sections.text: ZBTB16 encodes PLZF, a zinc-finger transcriptional repressor involved in development and differentiation.
RARA encodes retinoic acid receptor alpha, a ligand-regulated nuclear-receptor transcription factor.

The fusion retains RARA DNA- and ligand-binding regions within an abnormal transcriptional regulator that blocks myeloid differentiation. It produces an APL-like leukemia with a molecular mechanism distinct from PML::RARA.

ZBTB16::RARA and STAT5B::RARA leukemias have shown resistance to ATRA and arsenic-based differentiation treatment; the high sensitivity of conventional PML::RARA APL must not be transferred to these fusions.
